property_summary: For any caller and any block state, when play() is called with exactly TICKET_AMOUNT (10) the reference contract always sets pot to 0 whenever its internal pseudo-random bit equals 0; the mutant flips the branch to random==1 so there exist inputs (producing random==0) where the mutant leaves pot non-zero, violating this rule.
change_summary: Change the condition so the winner branch executes when random == 1 instead of 0, altering when pot is reset.
